title: Elspeth 2026 Wombo-Combo
author: Dwjliel
description:
I wanted a sexy but still mystical Elspeth for when I confederated her into Franz's harem.

NEW FOR MARCH 2026!:: 9 variations offered, all-in-one selectable in-game via Varient Selector Mod <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2888171970>!

There's roughly 3 types:

-
Young no nipples (same as steam)

-
Young with nipples out, short cloak colour variations

-
Older, more like original with shorter hair.

Each of these 3 types has THREE VARIENTS, for 9 total options.

They have specific/individual Porthole AND Unit cards, that change depending on which variant you have selected.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NONE OF THE CREDIT IS MINE.

I've just kitbashed other talented modders work.

NONE OF THE CREDIT IS MINE.

@LazyIcarus <https://www.loverslab.com/profile/59454-lazyicarus/> please say if you're not happy to have this mod hosted.
